predecessors.name: Sultanate of Berau
predecessors.text: Berau, 'dipecah menjadi dua, yaitu Sambaliung dan Gunung Tabur pada sekitar tahun 1810-an'

ledger.x: 1810: Sultan Alimuddin founds the capital of Sambaliung at Tanjung, after Berau divides in two.
1810: Sambaliung takes its half of the divided Berau Sultanate (the other half is Gunung Tabur, which needs its own dossier).
1834: the Dutch conquer Berau and Sambaliung falls under Dutch overlordship.

December 1949: Dutch sovereignty ends ('Dutch–Indonesian Round Table Conference: 27 December 1949'; 'In December 1949 the Netherlands formally recognised Indonesian sovereignty', Dutch East Indies page) and with it the Dutch protectorate over Sambaliung.

December 1949 to 1960: Sambaliung continues as a swapraja (self-governing region) inside Indonesia until 'penghapusan swapraja pada tahun 1960'; the republic-of-indonesia dossier takes the Indies land in December 1949.
1960: the swapraja is abolished ('hingga penghapusan swapraja pada tahun 1960').
1960: the Sambaliung sultanate ends with the abolition of the swapraja.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary: the river-basin domains of Berau and its neighbours Gunung Tabur, Bulungan and Kutai are approximate.
